courses.note: The plan of study requires one of CSC 205 Computer Organization or CSC 215 Computer Systems (4th semester); CSC 215 (hierarchical structure of computer systems, memory, CPU, operating system interactions) was chosen as the systems course, with CSC 205 as the alternative. No operating systems or security course is in the plan, so this is a required-choice course, not an elective. NOVA's online schedule pages list syllabi for these sections but they were not retrievable (redirect to a 404), and no public term syllabus was found.

notes: Two-year transfer program (AS), not a bachelor's; the nearest primary CS degree. Frame from the NOVA catalog plan of study.
